title: Haar Wavelet Downsampling: A Simple but Effective Downsampling Module for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Haar DWT plus 1x1 conv as the downsampling operator, so stride-2 steps keep high-frequency detail in subband channels instead of aliasing it away.
adaptation: Swap the ResNet-34 stem max-pool for HWD (all ImageNet weights kept), and optionally the layer2 entry stride. A 1 to 2 px crack is partly lost at the first max-pool on a 512 px cell.
min_experiment: Arm: house and PF with an HWD stem, 5 seeds. Baseline: house / PF. Metric: crack components >= 20 px found, crack recall at relP@2 >= 0.90. Kill: components found < +0.02 and crack IoU not up.
evidence: R: segmentation gains across modalities and backbones and a lower feature-entropy index, as stated in the abstract and README. I saw no thin-structure numbers.
prior_overlap: none. D09 proposes a similar wavelet stem through NWG-DETR.

alt_notes.adaptation: Replace the ResNet-34 stem max-pool (optionally the stride-2 entry of layer2); a 1 to 2 px crack is half lost at the first max-pool. Combine with Seg-Aliasing if both pass.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house with HWD stem; baselines house and PF; 5 seeds; crack components found, recall at relP@2 >= 0.90, crack IoU; kill if components found < +0.02 and crack IoU not up. About 6 GPU-h.
